requirements.text: - BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- 3+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with a proven track record of contributing to team-based projects.
- Proficiency in modern programming languages, specifically C/C++, Go, or Python, with a strong grasp of data structures and algorithms.
- Solid understanding of backend development and the lifecycle of a production-grade service.
- Distributed Systems: Deep knowledge of distributed systems, concurrent programming, and microservices architecture.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with container technology (Docker/Kubernetes) and common open-source systems such as MySQL, Redis, or MongoDB.
- Efficiency & Optimization: Experience in performance tuning and identifying bottlenecks in large-scale distributed environments.
- Collaborative Mindset: Strong communication skills and a passion for building secure, high-impact enterprise tools.
